facts.fact: coda 开题：无垠宇宙、一个世界的 mass grave 中——一个名字被说出。
名字的运力清单：memory/weight——「It carried the consequences of everything that it had forged and destroyed and forged anew at the core of the universe, the crux of creation.」——锻造、毁灭、再锻造。
千风俗尽忘：「A thousand customs and a thousand more traditions. All gone. All forgotten.」——但名字活着。
唯一目的：「It had survived through centuries and centuries only to keep that vital core alive.」——vital 呼应 Nikolas 的 call it vital。
facts.anchor: It had survived through centuries and centuries

facts.fact: 收束：穿过磁场、quintessence 带、星风——「it remembered.」——全书最后一个动词是「记起」。
